answer: At dawn each epoch a sealed auction opens. Each identity files a key-signed bid and a 70-credit bond; the zenith bid wins a slot, losers refunded. Auditors replay the bid ledger; a key signing two bids, or a reused bid, burns the bond. First bid 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. A comet-bid ring streaking late bids pays full price per bid. Honest agents bid once, pay 45, reclaim it next epoch.
